summary: American Airlines filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a pass-through trust issuance of $905,038,000 Class A Pass Through Certificates, Series 2026-1A. The offering finances 32 aircraft via equipment notes secured by the aircraft. Natixis provides a liquidity facility covering three semiannual interest distributions. The certificates are not listed on any exchange. This is a routine debt securitization, not a special situation, as it involves ordinary capital raising for fleet financing. No change of control, restructuring, or strategic event is present; the filing is a standard shelf takedown under Rule 424(b)(5).
